The main takeaway from our work is that
capillary AChE activity is a good indicator of the peripheral AChE inhibition produced by eptastignine in healthy volunteers.

we have developed a rapid, reliable and portable technique to measure AChE and BChE activities in capillary blood, allowing the monitoring of eptas-tigmine pharmacodynamic activity in Alzheimer patients without venepuncture.
